Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
from google.api_core.client_options import ClientOptions

def extract_invoice_fields(pdf_path: str) -> dict:
    # Provider-identifying signal: Google Cloud Document AI
    project_id = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID")
    location = "us"  # Must be "us" or "eu"
    processor_id = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID")  # Pre-trained Invoice Processor
    processor_version = "pretrained-invoice-v1.2-2023-11-10"  # Concrete model identifier

    # Initialize client
    opts = ClientOptions(api_endpoint=f"{location}-documentai.googleapis.com")
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(client_options=opts)

    # Read the file
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as file:
        content = file.read()

    # Configure the processor
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}/processorVersions/{processor_version}"

    # Process the document
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(
        name=name,
        raw_document=documentai.RawDocument(content=content, mime_type="application/pdf")
    )
    result = client.process_document(request=request)

    # Parse the response
    document = result.document
    entities = document.entities

    # Extract fields
    extracted_data = {
        "vendor": None,
        "date": None,
        "total": None,
        "line_items": []
    }

    for entity in entities:
        if entity.type_ == "supplier_name":
            extracted_data["vendor"] = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "transaction_date":
            extracted_data["date"] = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "total_amount":
            extracted_data["total"] = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "line_item":
            line_item = {
                "description": None,
                "quantity": None,
                "unit_price": None,
                "amount": None
            }
            for prop in entity.properties:
                if prop.type_ == "line_item/description":
                    line_item["description"] = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/quantity":
                    line_item["quantity"] = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/unit_price":
                    line_item["unit_price"] = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/amount":
                    line_item["amount"] = prop.mention_text
            if any(line_item.values()):
                extracted_data["line_items"].append(line_item)

    return extracted_data
```
